implementationCases.description: Explicit ordinary Attack tile-scan policy, fresh baseline/ability reset/scenario/target selection certificates
Immutable supplied scenario subset validated against original FlatOrdinaryMovement AiOrigins; duplicate/unknown cells reject
Source radius-one cast intersection and AoE-zero occupied aim tile; final weapon range excludes distance zero
Stable layer/y/x ordering independent of collections and actor original slot identity
Actor-origin becomes ActThenMove to supplied scenario destination; other origins become MoveThenAct
Stay emits one ActThenMove and duplicate final destinations retain distinct source origins/orders
Inactive target, empty mask and filtered origins give NoCandidates with no RNG including MAX
Usable/canonical/score/geometry admission precedes empty scan; unknown facts never imply support
Actual formula queried once per emitted candidate, never public cached results or repeated pair comparison
NotValuable consumes four draws, keeps aim for later origins and does not stop scan; all absent has no selected score
Strict private incumbent priority/hit/proximity comparison; signed/zero scores and exact earliest ties
Baseline eligible foe/cache persists through projected Dead and each new candidate starts from original state
Only decision RNG is carried for every completed candidate, including losing/NotValuable outcomes; no extra scan draws
Whole-query early/late draw or tick overflow rollback, failed index and nested typed reason, exact MAX success
Replay/input/profile/branch preservation for both IDs/collections and no authoritative RNG or command publication
Historical fixtures unchanged; source resume cursor trace documented but new API synchronous with no native time/frame checkpoint
